transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. AI. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling constantly depressed and sad, and it just doesn't seem to lift. It's been going on like this for about two years now, and I'm just so tired of feeling this way.
Have there been any periods during the past two years when you felt better for more than two months at a time?

I don't think I've had any long stretches of feeling better. It feels like this heavy mood has just been constant without any real breaks. I really can't remember a time in the last two years where I felt okay for that long.
